title: Not enough
body: It would be better if there was an option to choose daily / weekly / monthly goal and eg. minutes instead of times per day.
author: lamadag

title: Aż chce się pracować nad nawykami
body: Aplikacja jest ładna i przejrzysta, a przede wszystkim prosta w użyciu. Do tej pory żadna tego typu na tyle nie przypadła mi do gustu na tyle żeby pozostac z nią na dłużej.  Avocation naprawdę zachęca do pracy nad sobą.
author: Drach3n

title: Keep up the good work!
body: I really like this app so far. What I miss is a bit more of personalization (maybe same profile picture with few options to put in about yourself; weight/fitness tracker would be cool but I guess it is more work) and option to customize the order of habits (drag and drop would be great!) and maybe more icons. Still this is the only app that really resonates with me and it is worth every penny
author: duuszkaa

title: Clean & Simple
body: In general it is a very good app, what I am missing is a version for Apple watch, some widgets and options to tweak what kind of notifications are enabled (for example I don't like welcoming notification at 8 am, but I would like to keep notifications reminding me about not completed habits)
author: sskxx
